text: この　タマゴは　うまれる　まで　まだ　かなり　かかりそうだ…

structure.jp: まだ　かなり　かかりそうだ…
structure.en: looks like it will still take quite a while...

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そうだ on the stem of a verb says 'it looks like it will' do that. かかりそうだ = 'looks like it will take a while'.

patterns.name: 〜まで
patterns.explanation: まで after a verb means 'until' that thing happens. うまれる まで = 'until it hatches'.
